entity: Wyoming-Utah-Nevada Chapter of Outdoors Unlimited, Inc.
summary: The Wyoming-Utah-Nevada Chapter of Outdoors Unlimited argues that the draft environmental statement is overly negative and fails to find constructive ways to accommodate ORV use on public lands. They contend that the statement's undefined terminology will lead staff officers to apply the most restrictive interpretations, unfairly burdening project development and ORV users. They also criticize the statement for not adequately addressing the positive benefits of ORVs in opening public lands to millions of people, and suggest that preservationist interests are selfishly restricting public land access.
